dTip.age: Tohu: E taea kore te pakeketanga. Wehea koe i mua i tō matenga.
dTip.eaten: Tohu: Pōhēhē i ngā kaiwhakangau, whakamahia te wā mārie hei rere.
dTip.lysis: Tohu: Ko ngā huaketo te take o te pakaru pūtau. Noho tawhiti atu i a rātou.
dTip.starve: Tohu: Kainga auau, noho tata ki ngā rōpū kai, ka whakarerekē tō tere.
dTip.temp: Tohu: Mātaki i te inemahana. Whakarerekē tō rohe pāmahana.
demo.tip: DEMO · rere WASD/kiore · 1-6 peke rōpū · pāwhiri = uru
dna.pastePh: Whakapiria te waehere DNA ki konei...
edu.chloro.desc: Tāpoi mārama: mārama + CO₂ + H₂O → huka + O₂. Ko te kākāriki nō te kōrorophin. Kei roto i ngā rimurimu me ngā tipu.
edu.chloro.name: Pūtāpoi
edu.cilia.desc: Ngā makawe poto e neke ana. Whakaputa au wai: neke + kai tātari (kumea ana ngā huaketo pūtau me ngā rimurimu ki te waha).
edu.cilia.name: Makawe poto
edu.cyto.desc: Te taiao roto o te pūtau: wai, pūmua, pūtauhanga. E ngā mano urupare ōkawa e pai ana i konei.
edu.cyto.name: Wairoto pūtau
edu.flagella.desc: He mīhini kaukau roa. Ka huri, ka konihia rānei — ka kau te pūtau ki te kai, ka rere rānei i te mōrearea (chemotaxis).
edu.flagella.name: Kotaha
edu.hoverHint: Whakamātakitakina te ira i roto i te pūtau — te ingoa me te tūranga o te pūtauhanga
edu.membrane.desc: He kōpaki ngako tīpato. Whakahaere ana i ngā mea e haere mai, e haere atu. Ko tēnā pūtau, ko tēnei, he kiri tōna.
edu.membrane.name: Kiri pūtau
edu.mito.desc: Te whare hiko o te pūtau. Manawa: huka + O₂ → ATP (pūngao). He DNA tōna ake — he toenga o tētahi huaketo pūtau o neherā.
edu.mito.name: Pūhiko
edu.nucleoid.desc: Te wāhi o te DNA porowhita i ngā prokaryote. Kāore he kōpaki kano — e noho māori noa ana ngā ira i roto i te wairoto pūtau.
edu.nucleoid.name: Wāhi kano
edu.nucleus.desc: Ka penapena i te DNA. Whakahaere i te tipu, te wehenga me te hanga pūmua. Kāore he kano tūturu ō ngā huaketo pūtau — kei te wāhi kano te DNA.
edu.nucleus.name: Kano
edu.oral.desc: Ki ngā mea makawe poto — he awaawa e pōkaikaha ana ngā makawe i te ngaki. Mai i konei ka uru te kai ki te poka nakunaku.
edu.oral.name: Awaawa waha
edu.vacuole.desc: He poka wai, kai tāpua, ngā enzyme nakunaku rānei. Ko ngā mea makawe poto he poka nakunaku me te poka kukume tō rātou.
edu.vacuole.name: Poka
edu.wall.desc: He anga pūmau ki waho o te kiri (peptidoglycan ki ngā huaketo pūtau, selulose ki ngā tipu). Whakamarumaru me te āhua.
edu.wall.name: Anga pūtau
filterHint: pāwhiria tētahi pātene kē kia huri
help.body:
Whakahaere: WASD kau. Space = ngau. Kiore = kau ki te tohu.

Ko wai e kai ana i te aha:

🌱 Ko ngā otaota e kai ana i te mārama. 🔵 Ko ngā kai iti e kai ana i ngā otaota. 🟠 Ko ngā kai waenga e tātari ana i ngā huaketo pūtau me ngā otaota. 🟣 Ko ngā kaiwhakangau nui e kai ana i ngā otaota, huaketo pūtau me ngā kai waenga — ā, ka ngau kahore i ngā ngaki nui ake i a rātou anō.

Kamēra: F noa, V hoki ki te pūtau. Porowhita = whakatata.

Wehenga: Kai, tipu, wehe. Q = ringa.
lb.title: 🏆 Rarangi kaiaka
mapTip: Mahere iti: kei hea koe i te roto. Mā te pāwhiri e peke te kamēra.
menuSub: Whakatauarite moroiti — {n} momo + huaketo. Tirohanga tapawhā o te roto.
midEaterTip: Kai waenga: kau ki ngā otaota, ki ngā huaketo pūtau rānei. Ka tātari ake ngā makawe poto.
noSpecies: Kāore he momo i "{cat}". Pāwhiri Katoa.
poolWill: Ka whai ~{n} ngāora te roto · {kinds} momo
popTip: Hoahoa taupū: e hia ngā moroiti i ia wā.
role.consumer1: Ngā kai iti (huaketo pūtau). Ka ngau i ngā otaota. He kai mō ngā kai waenga me ngā mea nui.
role.consumer2: Ngā kai waenga (mea makawe poto). Tātaritia te wai: kumea ngā huaketo pūtau me ngā otaota. Kaua e whawhai ki ngā nunui.
role.consumer3: Ngā kaiwhakangau nui. Ka kai i ngā otaota, huaketo pūtau me ngā kai waenga. Ka ngau i ngā ngaki nui ake i a rātou anō — he mōrearea. Ka ora roa pēnā kore kai, engari ka matekai tonu.
role.decomposer: Ngā kaipēhu. Ka horoi i ngā mea mate — kāore e whakangau i ngā mea ora.
role.macrophage: Ngā kaitiaki. Ka whawhai i ngā pūtau māuiui, mōrearea rānei — te parepare o te roto.
role.producer: Ngā otaota. Kāore he whakangau. Ka kai i te mārama me te wai — he tipu paku. Ka whāngai i te katoa.
roleHint: Tohu: he porowhita whai tae tō te kai. Kei runga rawa te pae kakara kai i te taha matau.
roleWho: Ko wai koe / ka kai i te aha
tip.ageBar: Pakeke o te ngāora. Ka tere ake te ngaro pūngao i ngā pūtau tawhito.
tip.cbFilter: Tātari ngāora. Pāwhiri kia whakaatuhia tēnei momo anake i te pae kōwhiri.
tip.daysL: Ngā rā tākaro. Ka pāngia te pāmahana e ngā huringa o te tau.
tip.energyBar: Pūngao o te ngāora. Ka heke haere. I te kore — matekai.
tip.fly: Rere noa: F, WASD / kiore rānei
tip.fpsL: Ngā tānga i ia hēkona (FPS). Whakaatu i te mahi o te tākaro.
tip.lightL: Taumata mārama. He mea nui ki te tāpoi mārama a ngā rimurimu.
tip.popC: Hoahoa taupū. Whakaatu i te hītori whānau me te mate.
tip.tempL: Pāmahana o te wai. Ka whakaonga ki te tāpoi kai me te oranga.

toast.cyst.hunger: Matekai: kua kākanohia — rapua he kai, whakaohohia
toast.divfail: Wehenga: kāore i puta te pūtau tuarua
toast.divide.blocked: Kāore anō e taea te wehe
toast.eat.none: Kāore he ngaki tata — kau tata ake
toast.eat.noneAuto: Kāore he ngaki tata — whakahoaho AUNOA, kau tata ake rānei

tut.s1.body: He moroiti koe i te roto. Te whāinga: kai, tipu, wehe. Pāwhiri Tonu.
tut.s1.title: Nau mai
tut.s2.body: WASD mō te kau. Ko te kiore e tohu ana i te ahunga. Neke, kātahi pāwhiri Tonu.
tut.s2.title: Neketanga
tut.s3.body: Kau ki tētahi pūtau iti ake, ā, pēhi KAI (E). Ka kite koe i tētahi whiti.
tut.s3.title: Te kai
tut.s4.body: Ka pīratea te pūngao, pēhi WEHE (Q). Ka iti iho te pūtau. He mea noa tērā.
tut.s4.title: Wehenga
tut.s5.body: Kamēra: whai, rere noa rānei. Kia tau te waimarie mō tō whakawhanake!
tut.s5.title: Oti
